meta.title: Help center
meta.description: Answers to common questions about {siteName}: getting started, posting a listing, contacting owners, safety, verification and payments.

hero.title: How can we help?
hero.lead: Search our answers, or browse by topic. If you can't find what you need, our support team is happy to help.

search.label: Search the help center
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No answers found} one {One answer found} other {{countText} answers found}}
search.noResultsBody: Try different or fewer words — or ask our support team directly. We usually need just a few details to help.

topics.title: Browse by topic
topics.count: {count, plural, =0 {No questions yet} one {One question} other {{countText} questions}}

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.emptyTopic: No questions in this topic yet
faq.emptyTopicBody: We're still writing answers for this topic. Our support team can help you right away.

empty.title: Our answers are on their way
empty.body: We're still writing the help center. In the meantime, our support team will gladly answer any question.

contactOptions.title: Still need help?
contactOptions.lead: Our support team reads every message and answers in your language.

ticket.title: Open a ticket
ticket.body: Follow the conversation in your account and attach screenshots.

contact.title: Contact form
contact.body: No account? Write to us and we'll answer by email.

safety.title: Safety Center
safety.body: How to spot scams and stay safe as a guest or owner.

scam.title: Report a scam — urgent
scam.body: Asked to pay up front? Tell us now — scam reports are handled first.

security.lead: Found a security problem in the site itself?

replyTime.promise: Replies within one business day, Sunday to Thursday. Messages sent Friday or Saturday are answered on Sunday.

scamReport.title: Report a scam
scamReport.lead: Asked to pay in advance, to send card details or a code, or saw a site pretending to be Bayit? Tell us — scam reports are handled before anything else.
scamReport.urgent: Don't pay and don't send any code until we get back to you. If you already paid, contact your bank or card company right away too.

asked_to_pay.label: I was asked to pay in advance
asked_to_pay.hint: By link, transfer, gift card or crypto.

card_or_code.label: I was asked for card details or a code
card_or_code.hint: For example a “card verification”, the CVV or a code you got by SMS.

fake_site.label: A site or email pretending to be Bayit
fake_site.hint: An address other than our site, or a message asking for payment in our name.

other.label: Something else that looks like a scam
other.hint: Tell us in your own words.

scamReport.siteHint: Don't open it again. We keep the address as text only.
scamReport.detailsLabel: What happened, in a few words
scamReport.detailsPlaceholder: Who contacted you, how, and what they asked for
scamReport.detailsHint: You can paste the link or account number they sent you: only our team sees it.

sent.title: We got your report
sent.bodyAccount: It's at the top of our queue. We'll update you in your account and by email.
sent.bodyEmail: It's at the top of our queue. We'll reply by email.
sent.meanwhile: Meanwhile: don't pay, don't send codes and don't open links they sent you.

errors.already_reported: You already reported this listing. We're on it.

fieldErrors.details_short: Write a few words (at least 10 characters).
fieldErrors.email_required: Write an email so we can reply.

tips.neverPay: Never pay in advance by link or transfer. You pay the host when you arrive.
tips.noLinks: Bayit never sends payment links or asks for card details.
tips.noCodes: Never give anyone a code you got by SMS or email.
tips.keepProof: Keep screenshots of the messages — they help us stop the scammer.
